steps.what: Read actual funding-call requirements and verify architecture research evidence and institutional facts in {DOCS}
Develop and capture the actual architectural research question, study sites or materials, methods, resource assumptions and limitations
Transfer exact call, researcher, institution and selected project fields into the {DOCS} grant template
Write grant proposals to procure external research funding, explaining the actual architectural research plan and evidence

loop.purpose: Draft grant wording around the teacher's actual research design
loop.input: Chosen research plan, verified evidence and call requirements
loop.output: Narrative with source pointers and unresolved facts marked
loop.check: Teacher checks the entire proposal against the call, research evidence, methods and resource assumptions in s5
loop.stop: Unsupported preliminary result, invented site access or missing commitment returns to manual research planning and writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates cover fixed fields; varied research explanations require bounded wording assistance only

steps.what: Complete and correct the whole grant proposal, checking scientific claims, site access assumptions, references, resources and call compliance
Save the proposal in the same {DOCS} working file without submitting it

tasks.design: Configure exact grant fields in {DOCS}, then draft variable wording from the teacher's actual architecture research plan and verified evidence. The teacher retains research design and complete proposal checking; no site permission, partner commitment or funding submission is invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grant authors repeat institutional fields and compose prose around decisions already made.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and constrained drafting can assist those distinct writing operations.
tasks.still_hard: Novelty, feasible architectural research methods and access assumptions need scholarly judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows which research claim the proposed evidence could actually support.

ambition.what: No assumed funding success or new research authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for confidential research access and institutional review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: template population and bounded wording drafts can assist grant writing while leaving research design and source verification human.

assumptions: Boundary is writing an actual research proposal, not submission or funding acceptance. The funder produces the call; record owners supply existing institutional facts; the teacher produces the research design and captures all selected fields in s1-s2. Missing evidence, resource facts or permissions require manual resolution and remain explicit uncertainties.

S3 explicitly transfers exact fields. Native templates first; existing populated fields earn no new gain. S4 retains edits and fallback; s5 retains complete source and scientific meaning checks. No outside grant-review work is sent to a model.

Ordinary authoring checks are not a new self-approval. The same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. Actual institutional approval and submission must occur after the final version with their real actors and separate send in the broader workflow.
Shares and cuts are hypotheses, not observed grant-writing baselines. No new partner, finance or site-owner effort is assumed free.
research_questions: Which fields are still copied manually and which narrative sections need original research reasoning?

already_counted.description: Source verification, research design and capture, drafting edits and full proposal checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain call-template fields and examine source support after drafting changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross=25; upkeep 4 gives net 21. Conservative case: an unusual call needs full manual narrative and only 5 field-copying points are avoidable, giving 5-4=1. Research design and full proposal verification remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise architecture students during office hours

steps.what: Open the student's current studio drawings, assignment brief and course references in {LMS} during the actual office-hours case
Maintain regularly scheduled office hours to advise and assist students, discussing their architectural reasoning, drawings and difficulties

tasks.design: Configure a direct current-submission and brief view in {LMS} for the actual advising case. The teacher still reads the drawings and holds the design conversation; no generated critique or student decision is substituted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct submission and brief can interrupt an advising conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course and submission links can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a student's design intent and giving useful critique are personal teaching work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher adapts guidance to the student's reasoning and learning needs.

ambition.what: No claim of additional student capacity.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for student access and workflow review; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct course-submission links can reduce navigation without replacing student advising.

assumptions: This is an actual office-hours advising episode. Student uploads and course briefs already exist from ordinary study and teaching; s1 verifies the student and version and includes the reading. Missing or external drawings are reviewed manually, not assumed digitized for free.

No termly scheduling setup is charged to every meeting. No separate note, attendance report or follow-up message is established by this statement; if one actually exists, separate its real writing and any send rather than burying it in the conversation.

Native links first; already direct submission access earns no new gain. Only repeated navigation changes, not drawing interpretation or live advice. Shares are provisional active effort, not measured office-hours time.
research_questions: Does direct submission access already remove repeated navigation during advice?

already_counted.description: Context reading and the full advising conversation remain.

incremental.description: Check course-view links after course restructuring.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=97, gross=3; upkeep 1 gives net 2. Low zero where submissions and briefs already open directly, so add no redundant configuration. All actual advice remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in recruitment registration and placement

steps.what: Retrieve the actual student or applicant case and current course or placement requirements in the {OTHER} student information system
Participate in student recruitment, registration, and placement activities through actual architecture course or placement discussions and case-specific advice
Write the teacher's actual course or placement recommendation in the {OTHER} case record, checking its meaning, evidence and case identifiers
Save the recommendation in the same {OTHER} case record without changing admission registration or placement status

tasks.design: Configure case-linked requirements and fixed identifiers in the {OTHER} student information system. The teacher discusses the actual architecture case and writes the recommendation; no model admits, registers or places a student.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation can require repeated case navigation and identifier entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and reference fields can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Course fit, portfolio interpretation and placement suitability require human discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher assesses the student's architectural goals and relevant learning context.

ambition.what: No new admission or placement authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-7 for student access, privacy and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: student case views and fixed-reference defaults can support participation without automating student decisions.

assumptions: Representative episode is teacher participation in an architecture placement or course case with an actual recommendation entry. Student services and students produce existing application and course records; s1 verifies match and reads requirements. Missing evidence is obtained manually; no new structured portfolio interpretation is assumed.

S2 forms the recommendation and s3 captures and checks all meaning. Only exact case/course identifiers default. Native configuration first; existing linked views earn no new gain. No admission, registration or final placement decision is inferred from this entry.

This working record save sends no notice and changes no student status. Any actual final status transaction or external communication needs its real authority and separate action after a final version exists. Student services' existing work remains unchanged and is not transferred or newly free.

Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval. Shares are provisional; do not extrapolate this placement-case example to all recruitment events or registration processing.
research_questions: Which teacher case operations remain repeated without contributing to the recommendation?

already_counted.description: Case reading, actual student discussions and complete recommendation capture/checking remain.

incremental.description: Check case and course-reference defaults after academic changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92.65, gross=7.35; upkeep 2 gives net 5.35. Low zero when case links and recommendation identifiers already default, so no duplicate tool is added. All student advice and recommendation meaning remain.

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Find and read the current committee agenda, architecture programme policy and relevant proposal versions in {DOCS}
Serve on academic or administrative committees that deal with institutional policies, departmental matters, and academic issues, debating the actual proposals and their effects
Write the teacher's actual assigned policy amendment in {DOCS}, checking its complete meaning against the discussion and original proposal
Save the working amendment in the same {DOCS} proposal file without enacting or publishing it

tasks.design: Configure current committee-source links and an amendment template in {DOCS} that carries exact policy and proposal references. The teacher reads, debates and writes the actual amendment; software neither decides policy nor creates automatic meeting minutes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee preparation and amendments can repeat policy and version references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and document fields reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional trade-offs and the effect of policy wording need collective judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher brings architectural education experience to the committee's reasoning.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for committee-source access and national consultation where required

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact proposal links and amendment fields can reduce reference repetition without replacing committee deliberation.

assumptions: Representative episode includes an actual assigned policy amendment. It does not invent minutes, a follow-up report or an amendment after every meeting. If the teacher only reads and debates, remove s3-s4 and estimate the actual episode separately.

Committee officers produce existing agendas and proposal versions; s1 checks them. S3 captures all amendment wording and verifies its complete meaning; defaults carry only policy, clause and version references. Missing or disputed versions require manual retrieval.

Native configuration first; existing links earn no gain. The same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval. Actual collective approval, enactment or publication belongs to the appropriate institutional authority after the final version and requires separate actions if included.
Shares are provisional active work, not measured committee times. No secretary work or additional colleague review is assumed free.
research_questions: Which repeated reference fields remain in actual policy-amendment writing?

already_counted.description: Source reading, deliberation and full amendment meaning checks remain.

incremental.description: Check proposal links and amendment reference fields as policies change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94, gross=6; upkeep 1.5 gives net 4.5. Low zero where committee documents already link their current versions and references, so introduce no duplicate tool. Deliberation and meaningful drafting remain.
